requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Syntactic ambiguity regarding 'enters the access card with the access code' was resolved using business rule BR-01. The phrase 'with the access code' indicates the means of authentication (keypad entry) rather than a property of the card. The requirement is structured as a single functional requirement describing the user's authentication action.

source_fragments: The user enters the access card with the access code.
structured_requirements.final_statement: The user shall enter the access code to authenticate.
structuring_notes: Resolved syntactic ambiguity: 'with the access code' refers to the method of entry (keypad), not the card property.
Action 'enters the access card' was interpreted in context of BR-01 as part of the authentication sequence, but the specific functional predicate for the system is the entry of the code.
Final statement focuses on the core functional action (entering the code) as the means of authentication.
